definitions.explanation: Getting ready for something, especially for going out or an event.

examples.japanese: {出|で}かける{支度|したく}をする。
examples.english: To get ready to go out.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{支度|したく}をしている。

notes:
{支度|したく} refers to getting ready, especially for going out or daily activities. More personal than {準備|じゅんび}.

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {支度|したく}: standard form
- {仕度|したく}: alternate writing (same meaning)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出|で}かける{支度|したく}: getting ready to go out
- {旅行|りょこう}の{支度|したく}: preparation for a trip
- {食事|しょくじ}の{支度|したく}: meal preparation
- {身|み}{支度|じたく}: getting dressed, grooming

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {準備|じゅんび}: preparation (general, formal)
- {用意|ようい}: readiness, preparation (for events/activities)
- {支度|したく}: personal preparation (getting ready)
